title: The Rich Live in the Sky. We Live in Their Shadow.
hook: The rich live in the sky
description: I climbed the forbidden ladder to the rich city in the sky. What I found up there… what would you do?

scenes.narration: In my city, the rich live in the sky. And we live in their shadow.
Down here, I haven't seen the sun in twelve years. Up there, they get it every single day.
There's only one way up. The golden elevator. And it only opens for a gold card.
I tried once. The guard didn't even look at me. He just pointed back down.
But before my grandpa died, he told me a secret. Pillar seven. There's an old ladder nobody has used in fifty years.
So at midnight, I started climbing.
Halfway up, the wind tried to rip me off. My hands were shaking. I didn't look down.
Then I pushed open the hatch. And for the first time in my life, I saw the sun.
Pools. Gardens. Golden houses. They were having breakfast like nothing was wrong.
Then I saw the mirrors. Thousands of them. All catching the sun.
That's when I got it. They didn't build their city up here to be closer to the sun. They built it to take it from us.
And down there, they sell it back to us. One hour of light costs a whole week of work.
Then the alarm went off. Guards. Everywhere.
Now I'm standing at the edge. Behind me, the mirrors. Below me, my whole city in the dark.
I could turn every mirror around. Or I could take the elevator home and pretend I never saw anything. What would you do?
